scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm run check:functions
scripts.gen:types: supabase gen types typescript --local > app/src/lib/database.types.ts && cp app/src/lib/database.types.ts supabase/functions/_shared/database.types.ts && prettier --write app/src/lib/database.types.ts supabase/functions/_shared/database.types.ts
scripts.check:functions: cd supabase/functions && for f in generate-plan generate-plans-batch generate-review export-my-data; do (cd $f && deno check index.ts) || exit 1; done && deno lint generate-plan generate-plans-batch generate-review export-my-data _shared/engine _shared/plans _shared/habits _shared/review _shared/llm _shared/ai
